content: Sapwellimen KAUN-O Kedlahs
KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong ie,
“Kowe, nein aramas, keriahla Serusalem. Keriahla wasa kan me aramas akan kin wia ie ar kaudok. Kehkehlingkihong wehin Israel
dahme ngehi, KAUN-O, ketin mahmahsanih: Iei ngehi me omw imwintihti. I pahn usada nei kedlahs oh kemeikumwailla, kumwail koaros me suwed oh mwahu.
I pahn doadoahngki nei kedlahs ong koaros sang ni paliepeng lel palieir.
Eri, aramas koaros ahpw pahn esehla me ngehi, KAUN-O, usadahr nei kedlahs oh sohte pahn kapwurehiong nan dewe.
“Kowe, nein aramas, makiaki duwehte ma omw mohngiong tihwohkilahr omw pwunod. Makiaki ni omw pahtou wasa me aramas koaros kak kilang uhk.

Ma re idek dahme ke wiewiahki men, ndaiong irail me pwehki rohng kan me pahn kohdo. Ni rohng ko eh pahn leledo, ar mohngiong pahn direkihla masepwehk, pehrail kan pahn mwoatoredi, nan kapehdirail pahn tikitikla, oh nehrail kan pahn rerrer. Ahnsowo leledohr; e miher wasaht.” KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, me mahmahsen.
KAUN-O eri mahsanihong ie,
“Kowe, nein aramas, wia kokohp. Ndaiong aramas kan dahme ngehi, KAUN-O, ketin mahmahsanih:

content.text: Kedlahs pwoat, kedlahs pwoat adahdadahr oh melenglenglahr.
pwehki nei aramas akan pohnsehselahr kehkehlik oh kalokolok koaros.
pwehn pwilidiong nan pehn sounkam aramas emen.
kedlahs wet pahn doadoahkohng nei aramas akan
I wie songosong nei aramas akan,
oh ma re sohte men wiliakapwala,
soahng pwukat koaros pahn lelohng irail.

content: Eri, kowe, nein aramas, wia kokohp. Lopwor pehmwen, oh kedlahso ahpw pahn kamaramas sohte kommoal. Iei kedlahs pwoat mehn kamaramas, kedlahs pwoat me kin kamasakada aramas oh kemeirailla.
E kin kahrehda nei aramas akan ar kin nan kapehd tikitikla oh dipekelekel. I pahn kamasangki ar kahnimwo kedlahs pwoat me kin piripir duwehte lioal oh kin onopadahr en kamaramas.
Palla ni palimeing oh maun, kowe, kedlahs keng! Palla wasa koaros me ke pahn pirekekla ie.
I pahn pil lopwor pehi kat, oh ei engieng ahpw pahn meleileidi. Ngehi, KAUN-O, me mahmahsen.”
Sapwellimen Nanmwarkien Papilonia Kedlahs
KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong ie,

“Kowe, nein aramas, elehda ahl riepwoat me nanmwarkien Papilonia pahn kak keid ie ketiki sapwellime kedlahso. Ahl riepwoat en pahn tepida sang nan wehi teieu. Wiahda ehu kilel wasa me ahl ako pahn kasangpeseng ie.
Kilelo pahn kasalehda elen nanmwarkio me kolahng Rappa, kahnimw en mehn Ammon kan, oh ahl teio kolahng Suda, oh ong Serusalem, kahnimw me kehl kelailo.

Nanmwarkien Papilonia pahn uh limwahn kilelo ni wetpeseng en ahlo. Pwehn kadoaropwe wasa me e pahn ketila ie, e pahn itik arep ko; ale kaweid sang rehn sapwellime dikedik en eni kan; e ahpw kasawih ehn mahn emen me meirongalahr.

Eri met! Lime palimaun kolokol arep me kileldi ‘Serusalem’! E alehier kaweid en ketila oh wiahda lepin tuhkehn kauwehla ewen kehlo, en wia weriwer en mahwen, en kihdiong lepin tuhken kauwehla kehlo ni ewen kehlo, wasahn poadoandoar, oh en wiahda warawar akan.
Mehn Serusalem kan sohte pahn kamehlele met pwehki inou lapo me re wiadahr. Ahpw kokohp wet pahn katamankin irail diparail kan oh kehkehlingkihong irail me re pahn lohdi.

Ih met me ngehi, KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, ketin mahmahsanih: Dipamwail kan sansaladahr. Aramas koaros eseier duwen amwail sapwung kan. Kumwail kasalehda dipamwail kan sang ni amwail mwekid koaros. Kumwail pakadeikadahr, oh I pahn pangkumwaillahng rehn amwail imwintihti kan.
“Kowe, kaunen Israel, aramas suwed, rahn omw lokolok leledohr.

Ngehi, KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, me mahmahsen. Kihsang sapwellimomwi nihn oh lisoarop en nanmwarki. Soahng koaros solahr pahn duweduwehte. Kasapwilada me semwehmwe kan pwe re en ahnekihla manaman! Kasapwildi me kakaun akan!
Kauwehla, kauwehla! Ei, I pahn wiahkihla kahnimwo mohn kahnimw ehu. Ahpw met sohte pahn wiawi lao mehmeno pahn kohdo me I piladahr en kaloke kahnimwo. Ong ih me I pahn ketikihong kahnimwo.
Kedlahs Pwoat oh mehn Ammon kan
“Kowe, nein aramas, wia kokohp. Kalohkihda dahme ngehi, KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, ketin mahmahsanihong mehn Ammon kan, me kapakapailoke mehn Israel kan. Padahkihong irail:

content.text: E melenglenglahr pwehn kamaramas, piripir duwehte lioal.

content: Kaudiahl kan me ke kilikilang sohte mehlel, oh kokohp kan me ke wiewia me likamw. Ke me suwed oh dipan, oh omw rahn pahn leledohr, rahnen omw lokolok. Kedlahso pahn lel ni tepinwaramwail kan.
“‘Kapwurehiong kedlahso nan dewe! I pahn kadeik uhk wasa me ke kepikipikda ie, nan sahpw me ke ipwidi ie.
Ke pahn kehn engin ei engieng ni ei pahn sapwadohng uhk duwehte kisiniei. Oh I pahn panguhkalahng rehn aramas lemei kan, me kin saman en kamwomwala wasa.
Kisiniei pahn kamwomwuhkala. Ntahmw pahn keredi nan pein sapwomw, oh sohte emen pahn pwurehng tamanuhkada.’” KAUN-O, me mahmahsen.
